provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: [L2-L3] (MED/error-contract) The filter suppresses matching warning lines but unconditionally exits 0, so upstream tooling cannot distinguish a successful filter from an input/read/grep failure.
audit_member_text: [L3] (LOW/error-propagation) The unconditional successful exit also masks grep execution or input/output errors, beyond neutralizing grep's ordinary no-selected-lines status.

base_member_text: [L2] (LOW/filter-semantics) The expression removes any line matching `warning:.*mpi_` without documenting case sensitivity, compiler format assumptions, or whether warning counts are expected to remain visible elsewhere.

audit_member_text: [L2] (MED/diagnostic-suppression) The filter discards every line containing warning: followed later by mpi_, potentially hiding substantive MPI warnings without limiting suppression to a known benign diagnostic.
